newsitem.title: ECUADOR: U.S. plane explodes over Ecuador city, 12 dead.
newsitem.headline: U.S. plane explodes over Ecuador city, 12 dead.

text.p: At least 12 people were killed when an American-owned Boeing 707 cargo plane exploded over a coastal city in Ecuador and crashed into a densely-populated neighborhood, local radio reported on Wednesday.

The Miami-bound plane, reportedly belonging to U.S. company Millium Air and with a crew of three Americans, blew up at 2240 Tuesday local time (0340 Wednesday GMT) shortly after taking off from the airport at the coastal city of Manta, 290 miles (480 km) southeast of the capital Quito.
Radio reports did not say whether the crew were killed, but said that emergency services were scouring the area for more dead or injured.
Ascribing the crash to presumed engine failure, the local radio said wreckage from the falling jet hit a church in the densely populated suburb of Dolorosa.
A local hospital official told Reuters that doctors were treating people with severe burns but did not know the number of dead.
The plane was carrying a cargo of frozen fish and flowers, according to the radio station.
